slides.title: Every linear question fits on ==one screen==
Graph both costs and click where they meet
slides.question: One landscaper charges \$50 plus \$35 per hour. Another charges \$55 per hour with no fee. After how many hours do they cost the same?
slides.caption: Graph both cost lines and click the crossing where the costs tie.

slides.title: Same slope, and you can see why
slides.question: How many solutions does the system $y = 2x + 3$, $y = 2x - 5$ have?
slides.caption: The lines are parallel and never touch. Zero crossings is what "no solution" looks like.

slides.title: Change = to < and it shades
slides.question: Which of the following points is a solution to $y < -2x + 6$?
slides.caption: Type the inequality and Desmos shades every solution. If the point sits in the shading, it works.

slides.title: Two inequalities, one answer region
slides.question: Which point satisfies both $y \le -x + 8$ and $y \ge 2x - 4$?
slides.caption: The darker wedge is where the shadings overlap. Any point inside it satisfies both.
slides.answer: Any point in the darker wedge, like $(4, 4)$
